Aeronautical Automation Operator in Portugal

“This my daily carry EDC gear on the job and on the go. I don’t change much. I just acquired my first Field Notes and the CIVIVI Yonder. I might swap the knife for a Kizer Feist and the watch for a Casio Edifice with a Tiffany dial when I’m not on the job.” — Ruben

CIVIVI Yonder
$56.95

Don't let this knife's price fool you into thinking it's an inadequate gift. The knife collector in your life has plenty to love in this Blade HQ alum Zac Whitmore design, which already has Best Buy of the Year at Blade Show 2024 under it's crossbar-locked belt. It's no-nonsense, ambidextrous, excellent EDC knife at a great price that makes for a great gift.

Buy Now
09/02/2026 06:58 pm GMT

Editor’s Note: I love how this carry strikes a great balance of minimalism and value. Having a magnetic wallet consolidated to your phone, an ultra compact key organizer, and smaller gear like a mini bolt action pen and a keychain flashlight make some pocket space for your newest additions like the notebook and pocket knife. And although it wasn’t pictured in this carry, the combo of the Kizer Feist and Casio Edifice are a great “dressier” duo that still aligns with that minimalist, high-value vibe. Thanks to Ruben (@ruben_b_caeiro on Instagram) for sharing!
